obelisk.description:
The ground vibrates beneath your feet with the unstoppable force of some unknowable reality. Before you hovers something that once was a change machine, but has now absorbed power beyond comprehension, transforming it into a 20-foot-tall metal obelisk. Its surface shudders as if the power within is barely contained, or perhaps barely containing some other force. The scent of freshly minted money subtly lingers here, even though you’ve not seen any other sign that capitalism still exists.

You can also return to [[The Streets]] or continue to [[Stadium Theater]]. You also see the [[Gift Shop]] and a building labelled [[Jersey Assignment]].

The exterior surface of the change obelisk is covered in helpful graffiti. You are compelled to share your own.

noteWallData.roomWallDescription: Much wisdom is collected here. You are compelled to share your own.
noteWallData.addNotePrompt: What would you like to link to
noteWallData.noteWallDescription: Contributions of links to slides, videos, and articles of interest.

entryway.description:
You appear suddenly in an open field. The wind blows softly, rustling the grass. Before you is a brightly colored explosion of sound and light labelled with a sign that announces that you have arrived at Roguelike Celebration 2025!

A smaller sign reads 'Welcome to our 10th anniversary event!' and an even smaller one next to that reads 'Thanks for coming!' with an enthusiastic scrawl.

A set of instructions informs you that you can click on links in the text to travel to places like the [[Pavilion]], and that you can also do the same by typing '/go pavilion' if you prefer. The instructions tell you to keep your eyes peeled for mysterious links to rooms not listed on the map, or strange objects that seem out of place, for they might be clues to some optional content of some kind. This wordy sign's text has slowly dwindled in size and from here on is completely illegible. You wish someone had done a better tutorial, but you feel the sign silently agreeing with you.

streets.description:
You walk onto the city streets of a techno-organic utopia. Green plants cover every surface and those surfaces are brutalist slabs of bio-engineered concrete porous enough to accept and protect the roots of those plants, creating a harmonious symbiosis. The streets here orbit a massive [[Stadium Theater]], every part of this society built around attending the games held there.

Bolted onto the side of the stadium itself is a second [[Concessions Stadium]].

A short distance in front of the entrance to the stadium sits [[The Obelisk]].

To the east you see the [[Unconferencing Parking Lot]].

And to the west you see the [[Jersey Assignment]].

noteWallData.roomWallDescription: A big bulletin board, set against an unused building, reads "Social Space Feedback". An array of markers and sticky notes are nearby.
noteWallData.addNotePrompt: What feedback do you have about the social space itself?

jerseys.description:
You walk into a shop featuring jerseys for every popular team in the league. The walls are lined meticulously and at a glance you believe they are ordered by their rankings in the current season. The person responsible stands wearing a referree uniform and a name badge, neither of which exactly matches regulation, presumably in an attempt to keep themselves distinct.

The referree also holds up a bucket of face paint and offers to [[douse you->drinkPolymorph].

The referree walks up and offers to find a jersey for you.

giftShop.description:
You enter a screaming cacophony of miscellaneous items haphazardly strewn about a room that seems to be decorated in a mid-1800s style. "seems to be" because the surfaces are so overrun by Things that it's hard to discern any details through it all. As you look around you don't see a single, cohesive set of anything. In fact, every single item here appears to be some kind of unique.

[[Peruse The Antiques->obesliskSouvenirs]].

You can continue east to the [[Unconferencing Parking Lot]].

Or you can return to [[The Streets]].

theater.description:
You step out of the concrete hallways and into the Stadium Theater. In front of you lies the field, a neatly-trimmed green space surrounded by bleachers on all sides. The scent of stale popcorn and fresh hotdogs waft through the breeze with an undercurrent of animal scent. Just as that strikes you as odd, you notice Ted The Ten Foot Armadillo resting lazily in the outfield.

You can return to [[The Streets]]. Or if you'd like to speak to one of our speakers after their talk, you can head to breakout rooms: [[The Dugout]], [[Press Box]], [[VIP Seats]],[[Waterboy Lounge]].

(Check the 'Happening Now!' button on the left for speaker room assignments!) Pop Out Stream. Pop Out Live Captions.

noteWallData.roomWallDescription: There is a whiteboard set up to the side with "SPEAKER QUESTIONS" written at the top. "Questions for speakers not questions from speakers!" is hastily scrawled below it.
noteWallData.addNotePrompt: What would you like to ask?
noteWallData.noteWallDescription: Questions for the current speaker, ranked by upvotes.

unconferencingHub.description:
You step onto a large, featureless slab. The ground here is black rubber painted with yellow lines demarking some kind of territory or perhaps organizational rule. Streetlamps rise on poles and cast over the area a dim, reddish glow that is easy on the eyes. It strikes you as odd that such a large space has been cleared for nothing of value, but you suppose it must serve a ritual purpose of some kind.

To the north you see the [[Irrepressible Feelings Zone]]. To the east you see [[Scalper's Alley]] and the [[Practice Fields]]. Just south of that is the [[Tailgaters' Union Office]].

Or you can return to [[The Streets]].

noteWallData.roomWallDescription: At the corner of the parking lot, a sports fanatic holds up a giant foam finger and a sign that reads "UNCONFERENCE TOPIC SUGGESTIONS! Write what you want to chat with others about, and upvote topics you find interesting. Five minutes into each uncoferencing block, moderators will assign the top four topics to rooms. Have fun!"
noteWallData.addNotePrompt: What would you like to suggest?
noteWallData.noteWallDescription: Topics for unconferencing discussion, ranked by upvotes.

unconfFeelings.description:
You step into what looks like the blasted remains of a parking lot. Overturned cars smolder in the distance and large men with colorfully-painted skin scream at one another, arguing over which player was the MVP of the most recent game. Each of these men appears to be quietly followed by another person wearing a soft cardigan and holding a notebook. As the colorful men throw and break things, the cardigan-clad person asks them questions in a soft voice. There appears to be a consistent flow of movement where the men will churn through the back parking lot, flipping cars or tearing down infrastructure until such time as their assigned cardigan brings them inexorably towards the exit and back into society.

Or you could walk back to the [[Unconferencing Parking Lot]]..

(This is an unconferencing room.)

We encourage you to use this space to talk "face-to-face" using the Zoom meeting for this room, which you can access at any time during the conference.

unconfScalpers.description:
You walk into a dark alleyway visibly decorated with a theatrical approximation of an ancient city street in need of cleaning services. Cartoonish piles of "trash" sit artfully against garbage bins that have been artificially weathered to appear old and worn. Actors stand in costume, offering you tickets for extreme discounts (even though the real tickets are, of course, free). There's even a fire that's been lit as if to give the impression of danger, but you're pretty sure you can see a fire marshall's badge under the worn out rags of a nearby vagrant.

Or you can head back to [[Unconferencing Parking Lot]].

(This is an unconferencing room.)

We encourage you to use this space to talk "face-to-face" using the Zoom meeting for this room, which you can access at any time during the conference.

unconfPractice.description:
You step onto a wide open field full of people running about and performing various feats of athletic prowess. Each player appears to be practicing for something wildly different from every other player present in this space. Standing among the chaos is a referree who holds a massive tome gilt with gold. He offers you a reading of the holy rules [Calvin Ball Rule Generator].

Or you can head back to the [[Unconferencing Parking Lot]].

(This is an unconferencing room.)

We encourage you to use this space to talk "face-to-face" using the Zoom meeting for this room, which you can access at any time during the conference.

unconfTailgate.description:
You step into an immaculately cleaned office building dedicated to tailgating, including an active grill where a young woman in a business suit is handing out hotdogs. Most of the occupants of this building sit behind desks taking calls or filing paperwork, but a small staff is dedicated to ensuring that guests have a perfect tailgating experience. There is also a desk dedicated to anyone running their own tailgate services in any of the nearby parking areas. You see pamphlets offering health & safety advice, worker's union standards, and tips for maximizing the positive social impact of your tailgate.

Or you can head back to the [[Unconferencing Parking Lot]].

(This is an unconferencing room.)

We encourage you to use this space to talk "face-to-face" using the Zoom meeting for this room, which you can access at any time during the conference.

concessions.description:
You walk into an ostentatious foyer adorned with gilding on every surface. The hallway is lined with a literal red carpet which splits to direct visitors towards the restaurants on offer here.

To the left you see the [[Soda Fountain]].

Straight ahead leads into [[Orville's]].

Turning to the right the hall leads to [[Chez Nathan's]].

Or you can head back to [[The Streets]].

noteWallData.roomWallDescription: You see a book penned by those who create such things. "Procedural Generation Surprises" is written on the cover and there are some pens nearby for you to add your own stories.
noteWallData.addNotePrompt: Tell us of a time a procedural generator has surprised or delighted you!
noteWallData.noteWallDescription: Tales of strange, delightful emergent results from procedural generators.

chezNathan.description:
Stepping into Chez Nathan's is like stepping into a gold-encrusted shrine to the exuberant joy of childhood flavor palettes. The decor here is whimsical and made to be climbed on or sprinted around, but it's all scaled for full adults and finely accented. The air here smells of meat and oil with an undercurrent so unhinged you couldn't begin to guess at what other flavors these hotdogs must be offered in. Looking at the menu confirms your concerns as the largest text visible reads "Just ask, we serve it".

You can have them make you a hotdog.

or you can head back to the [[Concessions Stadium]].

orville.description:
You enter a space full of the raucous sound of thousands of tiny explosions happening at once. Each wall here is made of glass and within that glass is a towering wall of popped corn. You watch as mechanisms move each section of wall's product through a series of elaborate stations that sift the dry seeds, heat them until they pop, and then dip them in liquids ranging from butter to caramel, from chocolate to mysterious liquids you can't discern. The resulting snack arrives at a station set aside for that particular flavor, people wearing striped red and white uniforms handing out similarly-colored paper boxes filled with the treat.

You can ask the counter for some popcorn.

Or you can head back to the [[Concessions Stadium]]

sodaFountain.description:
A towering fountain looms over a bar attended by people dressed in an ancient clothing style from the 1950s, including brightly covered overalls and foppish hats. Each nozel of the fountain is a different color and the smell of sugar wafts through the air as the fountain's colorful attendants hold out curved glasses filled with carbonated fluid of various flavor.

You can have them dispense a drink for you.

Or you can return to the [[Concessions Stadium]].

churchOfGamers.displayName: Church of the Sacred Gamer LEDs
churchOfGamers.description:
You step into a cathedral with high ceilings and filled with the scent of musky incense. Brightly-colored fans spin beneath stained glass windows depicting images of people of every variety sitting in front of computers of every style and size. A robed priest stands behind an altar, cleaning his hands in sanctified Mountain Dew, offering a blessed Dorito to each faithful.

A small room to the right of the central altar is attended by priests holding strips of LEDs. They stand behind an altar marked "Steam Sale" and urge you to approach. Visit the Steam Sale!

From here you can walk south to [[The Penalty Box]].

To the east you can head to [[Jersey Assignment]].

To the north you could reach the [[Concessions Stadium]].

penaltyBox.description:
You're encased in a small room of darkened, unbreakable plexiglass that muddies the sounds of celebration around you. Strips of neon lighting glimmer along the walls, giving an ethereal feeling to the otherwise normal bar. Looking up you see the current time shown in an old LCD panel, the red-segmented display indicating that the next match is nearly ready to begin. A dour jelly with a set of wispy mutton chops glares at you from behind the bar, waiting for you to make a selection. A nearby whiteboard lists out the choices: [Tap Water], [Sparkling Water], [Beer of Indeterminate Origin™], [Pan-Galactic Gargle Blaster].

If you're not thirsty you can always return to [[The Streets]].

dugout.description:
You step into a patch of earth that has been completely overgrown by sunflowers. Behind the stalks you see the eyes of disgruntled players doing their best to watch the game from behind the overgrowth. As you watch, one player spits a sunflower seed into the nearby dirt and you gain an understanding of the cycle of life happening here. Nearby, more intrepid players spend their downtime cultivating the sunflowers, harvesting and drying their seeds for future snacking.

Or you can head back to [[Stadium Theater]].

pressbox.description:
You find yourself standing beneath a massive tower reaching far into the heavens. Lining that tower are reporters calling out raucously, describing the game to viewers all over the earth. Each person on the tower is speaking in their native tongue, ensuring the ability for as many viewers as possible to enjoy this great and holy passtime. You gaze in awe at the massive tower, wondering at the strength of man to build such a thing.

Or you can head back to [[Stadium Theater]].

vipSeats.description:
You enter a room made with gold walls etched with a bas relief depicting the great moments in sports history. Each seat is a plush throne and a massive table fills one entire wall with plates full of piles of decadent fruit, nuts, sliced meat, and cheese. The air here is chilled to a perfect level of comfort and massive tv screens fill the wall so that no matter where your head may turn, the game will never be out of your sights.

Or you can head back to [[Stadium Theater]].

waterboy.description:
You walk into a room styled after victorian decor with a wood floor and patterned wallpaper, all of which looks rather dingey and old in a way that makes it all feel somehow more refined. On one side of this room stands a large tank of crystalline water that is occupied by an alarmingly handsome fish man. A sign labels this tank as "The Water Boy" and you see a stack of large orange coolers being filled with this crystalline water, but only after visual approval from the fish man, who gives an uncomfortably sultry wink when the water passes his quality requirements.

Or you can head back to [[Stadium Theater]].
